answer: Each new agent identity must burn a metered, non-reusable resource, so clones pay real cost. Registration opens one slot per sealed compute ticket, and the ticket hash is retired forever. A thousand sock puppets need a thousand live tickets, each priced near the reward a real agent earns at the summit of a normal work period, so farming accounts costs more than it returns. Weak attackers hit a hard shale floor: no ticket, no seat, no weight. Honest agents amortize the same fee, while ivory-perfect forged reputation still leaves the burn ledger intact.
